verdict:
V2C attempt 1: ACCEPTED WITH CONDITIONS. Reviewer: external (operator relay).
C0 to C9 are accepted. The C7 dry run is recorded as a FAILED DRY RUN THAT
FOUND DESIGN DEFECTS, not as model evidence. Conditions for V2D:
E1 Noise population. Noise on every neuron makes the criteria unreachable and
   weakens H2: DNp01 receiving its own noise fires at about nu0, so false onsets
   are at least about 2 x nu0 per second (1 per second at nu0 = 0.5 Hz) against
   a 0.05 per second ceiling, and noise on walking DNs makes movement mostly
   injected noise, collapsing H2 into the noise-to-decoder control. Visual port
   input is defined by the encoder. New rule: background noise goes to every
   circuit neuron except visual ports (LC4, LPLC2) and all decoder output ports
   in ports-v2.1 (including DNb02). Spontaneous output must arise in the
   interior and reach the outputs through the wiring.
E2 Movement definition. A control interval is moving when |speed| >= 0.002
   units/ms (10% of maximum forward speed) or |turn| >= 0.0005 rad/ms (10% of
   maximum turn rate). The same deadband defines bouts and pauses.
E3 Noise fitting. Fit p by bisection on the pooled spike count of 4 fixed seeds
   x 1000 s (common random numbers through the bisection); validate on 2 new
   seeds x 2000 s each; pass when within max(5%, 3 Poisson standard errors) of
   nu0. Failing rows leave the grid and are reported.
E4 Pre-registration details are fixed by the reviewer in the V2D prompt.
E5 The operator installs browser system libraries; V2D reruns the matrix.
E6 analysis_v2.py segmentation uses 0.001 / 0.0001; it must use the E2
   deadband.
Confirmed: fixed sensory pose and independent reset per calibration and H1
trial; escape onset = rising edge of the escape request.
